title: Sea of Steel
author: Impressive_Ad4241
selftext:
As solo as it gets! After many many years of working in large and small teams.. Launching some really big games and some not so big games.. I am finally ready to spend the 10  years or  so in the genre I love the best.. RTS.. I have a whole series planned in my head.. but it starts here. 

SOS - **Sea of Steel - Is a tactical bathtub RTS based around the pacific in ww2.**   

It's both serious and accessible with an aim to create a challenging Naval experience but not requiring an 80 pages manual.. (manual is 20ish pages) 

Primarily using CODEX with a team of agents. A big part of this has historical research and training a blender agent to build models to spec.. including using schematics  to stay inside historical sizes and boundaries.   
  
Cheers!
